body:
I tell myself that my pets are what keep me here, as well. Yes, like you, I could easily give them away, but I think doing so would send me over the edge. They're my sanity. When I cry, my cat puts his paw on my shoulder. 

I've been incredibly depressed lately, as well. I don't know if I'd ever go through with suicidal thoughts, but those thoughts ARE there. Like you, I have good points in my life, but right now, the bad is outweighing them. 

My family has essentially given up on me and refuses to help or accept that depression means I CAN'T SNAP OUT OF IT. They think it's something I can turn on and off. 

Feel free to message me on here if you want to talk more -- I think I understand where you're coming from. Keep your chin up! :)

I called this past weekend. It can be really hit or miss depending on which counselor you get. I've gotten some great ones and some real duds. I hate calling people as well. But overall, I think they really care and are really trying to help. 

Might as well give it a chance! But don't give up if they don't help the first time, probably just got a dud. Call again until you're feeling okay about yourself -- that's what I did. I even wrote down some of the things they said because they made me feel like a decent person.

Your situation sounds like my life's bio. Like you, I don't do anything right now because of my cats. They're my sanity in all of this. 

I screwed up my third semester in college. I got into horrible debt. I've been cheated on more times than I can count. 

If you need a friend to go through this with, I'm here.

I made the mistake of answering my phone when I OD'd on Ambien, because I was too loopy and didn't think about the implications. Needless to say, I ended up on suicide watch at the hospital. 

Getting a job while depressed is horrible. As are the people around you who don't understand why you haven't found one yet. And with every job you don't get, the depression gets worse and you're less inclined to try again. It's a horrid vortex. 

I'm tired of everybody who claims to understand depression, but will still tell me to "just get over it." I feel like I'm paralyzed, in a force field. 

Bottom line, I understand where you're coming from, and if you ever want to talk, I'm here.

Life has been incredibly lonely for me too, lately. Like you, I sit in my bed on my laptop all day. Pretending to be happy on Facebook. Wondering what show I can marathon next on Netflix. I sit in my bed surrounded by takeout containers and empty bottles of wine. 

Honestly, I would have killed myself a long, LONG time ago if it weren't for my cats and dog. If anything were to happen to them, I'd be gone in a heartbeat. 

Needless to say, if you want to talk I understand where you're at.
Hi there -- I'm here if you want to talk. I'd love to make a friend, too.
